boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Mary, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A gentle, under-21-safe sequence for learning campus, meeting people, and taking in Bismarck’s public cultural and outdoor spaces.

cards.entity_name: SOAR: Student Orientation, Advising, and Registration
cards.title: Start with SOAR
cards.subtitle: University of Mary orientation
cards.notes: Use the orientation day to walk campus, meet an advisor, and note support services before making independent weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: Begin with the university’s formal introduction to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary describes SOAR as Student Orientation, Advising, and Registration, including campus exploration and meetings with faculty, staff, and students.
cards.access_notes: Register through the university’s SOAR page; dates and registration availability vary.

cards.title: Find the campus living room
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · University of Mary
cards.notes: Make Lumen Vitae your first indoor landmark: sit by the fireplace, orient yourself, and choose a meeting spot for later.
cards.short_summary: A central gathering place for a first campus reset.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Lumen Vitae University Center as the heart of campus, with sitting areas for students, faculty, and visitors.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Located on the University of Mary campus; access may depend on university building policies.

cards.title: Pause in the indoor green space
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Step into Lanterman Lodge for its plants, waterfalls, aquarium, and study nooks; use it as a calm break between introductions.
cards.short_summary: An indoor garden-like study and rest stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes Lanterman Lodge as a year-round lower-level LVUC green space with tropical flora, waterfalls, an aquarium, and study nooks.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Inside the Lumen Vitae University Center; follow building-access policies.

cards.title: Locate your involvement hub
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Find the Student Involvement Center, then save its location for club questions, a meeting room, or a focused study session.
cards.short_summary: A campus base for organizations and student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Mary handbook describes the Student Involvement Center as a hub for student organizations and activities, with gathering and study spaces.
cards.access_notes: The handbook places it in the lower level of LVUC and describes it as open 24 hours daily; confirm current building access with Student Involvement.

cards.title: Check what MAC has on
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · University of Mary
cards.notes: Check the student-life calendar or Student Involvement Center for a Marauders Activities Committee event that fits your first weekend.
cards.short_summary: Look for a university-organized social or cultural event.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary says the Marauders Activities Committee organizes on-campus social activities, cultural events, and entertainment options.
cards.access_notes: Events vary by date; consult the university student-life calendar for current details.

cards.title: See a Marauders game or recreation activity
cards.subtitle: Saturday · University of Mary campus
cards.notes: Look at the athletics calendar, then head to the McDowell Activity Center for a scheduled game or campus recreation activity.
cards.short_summary: A practical place to catch the university’s athletic energy.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary lists the McDowell Activity Center gymnasium as an athletics venue and describes year-round recreation and intramural opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled events and ticketing vary; consult the athletics calendar before going.

cards.title: Look for a performance in Arno Gustin Hall
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Harold J. Miller Center
cards.notes: Check the music calendar for a concert, play, musical, guest performance, or jazz event scheduled in this 350-seat hall.
cards.short_summary: A named campus venue for music and stage events.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary states that Arno Gustin Hall hosts concerts, plays, musicals, guest artist performances, and the University of Mary Jazz Festival.
cards.source_title: Music at Mary Facilities | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Programming varies; verify a current event and any admission requirement before attending.

cards.title: Set up a late study session
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · University of Mary campus
cards.notes: Register your MCard at the circulation desk if needed, then use a quiet or group study space to prepare for the week ahead.
cards.short_summary: A structured late-evening campus stop for settling in.
cards.evidence_claim: Welder Library offers individual and group study spaces, computer workstations, and September–April hours until 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: September–April hours list Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; breaks and holidays may change hours. On-campus borrowing requires MCard registration.

cards.entity_name: North Dakota Heritage Center & State Museum
cards.title: Explore North Dakota history
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · North Dakota Capitol Grounds
cards.notes: Choose a gallery or exhibit to explore, then use the museum’s directions page to plan your route and confirm the day’s opening hours.
cards.short_summary: A free public museum stop on the Capitol Grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The North Dakota Heritage Center & State Museum lists weekend hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Directions & Hours | North Dakota Heritage Center & State Museum
cards.access_notes: Located at 612 East Boulevard Avenue on the North Dakota Capitol Grounds; the museum lists weekend hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and holiday closures.

cards.title: Close the weekend on the river trail
cards.subtitle: Sunday daylight · Bismarck
cards.notes: Walk or roll part of the paved shared-use loop, then pause by the Missouri River; stay on marked public paths and plan for daylight.
cards.short_summary: A large public park with river access and a connected trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Bismarck Parks and Recreation lists Sertoma Park’s 3.2-mile paved shared-use loop, Missouri River shore access, and daily 6 a.m.–11 p.m. hours.
cards.access_notes: 300 Riverside Park Road; the park lists daily hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m. Use marked shared paths and observe posted park rules.
